business_summary: baby calendar Inc. operates an information site for pregnancy, childbirth, and childcare in Japan. The company engages in the medical corporation business for obstetrics and gynecology clinics to general hospitals. It also provides Baby Calendar, an information media for pregnancy, childbirth, and childcare; gramo to match companies for spread their products and services to the world with influencers; First Present, a gift that make the touching moment a lasting memory; Moon Calendar, an information site that provides various information; Woman Calendar, an anti-aging site for adult girls by girls; senior calendar, an information site that provides information for nursing care facilities for the senior care; Yomuuno, a comprehensive lifestyle information media; and postpartum care business, as well as web marketing services. The company was formerly known as Cookpad Baby Co., Ltd. and changed its name to baby calendar Inc. in May 2017. baby calendar Inc. was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
